method: Fama–French 5-factor + momentum alpha on the placebo TIMING overlay (active return vs buy-and-hold)
interpretation: Across 348 placebo timing overlays, FF5+MOM alpha t-stats centre at -1.07 (median annualised alpha -7.5%). Of the 54 that reach |t|>2, 54 are significantly NEGATIVE and only 0 positive — i.e. after controlling for market/size/value/profitability/investment/momentum, the divination timing produces no positive alpha; in a bull it is a structural drag (sitting out forfeits the premium). A real agent must show a positive FF-alpha t-stat; the same regression takes any agent return stream as a drop-in.
